about: Archive plates for the shorts. Each is a cut-free stretch of one shot from the cineosis-lab shot library (hartswf0/cineosis-lab, lab/clips/<id>.mp4), which found its shots through movingimagearchive.com's shot search. Trimmed and re-encoded without sound; no pixels painted. Times are seconds inside the lab clip; 'source' times are inside the original film.
